params.name: processing
params.default: the AI is processing the video...

params.name: processing_failed
params.default: the AI could not process this video

params.name: writing
params.default: watching the video and writing the script...

params.name: no_lines
params.default: the AI returned no usable lines

params.name: voice_mismatch
params.default: careful: {voice} does not speak {language}; the words will be read with the wrong mouth

params.name: translate_ready
params.default: translated into {language}: {n} lines - read them before generating

params.name: fitted
params.default: timing spread over the recording: {n} lines

params.name: draft_ready
params.default: draft ready: {n} lines — read and edit them before generating

params.name: line_overrun
params.default: — WARNING: runs {over:.1f}s into the next line; shorten the words or move the next start

params.name: picture_copied
params.default: kept as it is (every player handles it)

params.name: picture_converted
params.default: converted to H.264, so it plays anywhere with nothing to buy

params.name: step_mix
params.default: put the voices over the video

params.name: line_kept
params.default: line {n} of {total}: kept from the last run

params.name: partial_ready
params.default: ready to play: the first {n} of {total} lines, {seconds:.1f}s

params.name: nothing_ready
params.default: no line is voiced yet - there is nothing to play

params.name: line_late
params.default: line {n} starts {late:.1f}s late — the line before it was still speaking. Shorten the words or move its start.
